title: HELIX FinAidAward Resource
description: A financial aid award offered or disbursed to a student for an academic period.

student_ref.description: HELIX ID of the Student resource

fund_name.description: Specific fund or program name (e.g., 'Federal Pell Grant', 'Dean's Scholarship')

amount_disbursed.description: NOTE: Actual disbursements are now modeled in the Disbursement resource; retained here for backward compatibility.

efc.description: Expected Family Contribution / Student Aid Index at time of award NOTE: For 2024-25+ records, model the Student Aid Index on AidApplication (sai/efc_legacy); retained here for backward compatibility.

meta.description: HELIX metadata block — present on every resource

data_owner.description: Role or person responsible for data quality

classification.description: Data classification tier per HELIX Govern

ferpa_flags.description: FERPA enforcement flags, applied at Bronze->Silver identity resolution and checked by every consumer before disclosure. See govern/ferpa-disclosure-framework.json.

is_education_record.description: True if this record is a FERPA education record (34 CFR 99.3).

disclosure_basis_required.description: If true, a consumer must assert a valid 34 CFR 99.31 disclosure basis (or hold 99.30 consent) before data is returned.

directory_restricted.description: True when the student has an active directory-information opt-out (from FERPARestriction.restrict_directory). When true, NO directory information may be disclosed under the 99.31(a)(11) directory exception.

restricted_categories.description: Specific directory-information categories the student restricted (99.37). A field in this list must be withheld even if directory_restricted is false.

legitimate_interest_scope.description: Roles/purposes pre-authorized as school officials with legitimate educational interest for this record (drives the 99.31(a)(1) check).

study_disclosure_allowed.description: Whether this record may be released under a 99.31(a)(6) studies agreement (typically de-identified or under a written agreement).

program_ref.description: HELIX ID of the Program this award is associated with (if program-specific)

award_year_total.description: Total award amount across all terms in the academic year

cost_of_attendance.description: Institutional COA budget used for this award calculation NOTE: Full COA components are modeled on AidPackage; retained here for backward compatibility.

unmet_need.description: Remaining financial need after all awards NOTE: Unmet need is now computed on AidPackage; retained here for backward compatibility.

satisfactory_academic_progress.description: SAP status at time of award. Federal aid requires SAP compliance. NOTE: SAP is now modeled as its own lifecycle in the SAPEvaluation resource; retained here for backward compatibility.

helix_meta.description: HELIX metadata block — present on every resource

data_owner.description: Role or person responsible for data quality

classification.description: Data classification tier per HELIX Govern
